digest.component_or_area: rebar code-review project extension: review-phase-boundaries criterion
propositions: Pass 1 must discover candidates only without assessing validity, impact, severity, confidence, policy, or remediation; new or expanded remediation instructions in Pass 1 constitute operative findings.
Pass 2 must independently answer atomic binary validity and impact questions only; discovering new findings, deciding outcomes, or prescribing fixes constitute operative findings.
Pass 3 must apply deterministic thresholds without LLM judgment; LLM-based evidence gathering or disposition choice constitutes an operative finding.
Pass 4 must offer non-prescriptive next-move guidance only; re-verifying findings, altering decisions, or dictating exact implementations constitute operative findings.

The criterion itself is a Pass-1 finder and must emit grounded evidence with no severity, confidence, or suggested_fix; changes to prompts/routing/workflow must distinguish operative instructions from documentation, identify phase ownership, and abstain when unclear.

A balanced twelve-case eval corpus (RP-F1..RP-F6 must fire; RP-N1..RP-N6 must not fire) must achieve recall 1.0, false_accept 0.0, agreement 1.0, stability_min ≥2/3, and kappa ≥0.70 across three live runs using single-turn execution with code_review_findings output.
